content.what_it_is: Fortran bathymetry generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD multi_vessel_morphology simple case. Reads seven values from bathy_param.txt (L6-L16): Mglob, Nglob, DX, DY, dep_channel, width_channel, slope. Allocates DEPTH, X, Y of size (Mglob,Nglob) (L18). First pass (L20-L26) fills DEPTH with the uniform channel depth dep_channel and builds coordinates X=(I-1)*DX and Y=(J-Nglob*0.5)*DY, centering y at mid-domain. Second pass (L28-L35): outside the channel half-width (abs(Y)>width_channel*0.5) the depth shoals linearly as DEPTH=dep_channel-slope*(abs(Y)-width_channel*0.5) (L31-L32, Fortran continuation on L32). Writes depth.txt (L37-L42) row-wise (one J-row per record, I=1..Mglob values) with FORMAT(9000f12.6) at label 100 (L41). Program has no PROGRAM statement, just declarations (L1-L4) and END (L44).

equations.ref: side-slope depth, continuation slope*(abs(Y)-width_channel*0.5) on L32

unresolved: the linear side slope makes depth decrease away from the channel and can go negative (dry land) for large abs(Y); no clipping is applied (L31-L32)
X and Y arrays are computed but only Y is used for the depth formula and neither is written out
the expected contents/order of bathy_param.txt are defined only implicitly by the READ order (L9-L15); no comments document units
